summary: Implemented the rich_measure for Tree and rich.align.VerticalCenter feature. Changes: rich/tree.py adds Tree.__rich_measure__ (iterative, explicit stack, level counter, 4 cells per indent level). rich/align.py adds Align.__repr__, a width constraint in Align.__rich_console__ (measured maximum, or min with explicit width), and the VerticalCenter class (render, measure, repr) placed before the main guard. rich/console.py sets justify="default" in print's render options while still passing justify into _collect_renderables. CHANGELOG.md marks 9.8.0 as unreleased with an Added subheading and two entries. Tests added in tests/test_align.py (repr, VerticalCenter render/measure/tall content, nested Align width) and tests/test_tree.py (acceptance tree measurement expecting Measurement(11, 19)). Nothing committed. Tests were not run, per the instructions, so all new tests are unverified; the nested-Align expected string was hand-computed and is the most likely to be wrong. The CHANGELOG's existing markdown bullet now sits directly under the Added list, which may read as part of Added.
